# Fixture MachineImage and release manifests

CWE reads OS images and releases from `MachineImage`, `ClusterRelease` and
`NodePoolRelease` custom resources, not from the files under `../profiles/osProfiles`.
These manifests are the in-repo set for local runs and tests.

Generated by `make fixture-releases` from `../profiles/osProfiles`: one
`MachineImage`, one `ClusterRelease` and one `NodePoolRelease` per OS profile.
Do not edit by hand: `go test ./hack/osprofiles-to-crs` fails when this
directory is not an exact regeneration, and `go test ./internal/machinerelease`
(with envtest) installs them into a real API server.

Tilt applies them by default (`NKE_CONTROLLER_RELEASES_DIR` overrides the directory), the
gofail e2e installs them into envtest, and `make releases-install` applies them
to the cluster in `KUBECONFIG`.
